tad bhedasya api apāramārthika tvāt
tathā api vastu gatim anurūddhyā eva antaḥkaraṇa āśrita tvam uktam

original: vastuto vakṣyamāṇarītyā dharmisattāsamasattākabhedasya sādhyaśarīraghaṭakatāyāmātmāśritatvapakṣe siddhasādhanānavakāśādantaḥkaraṇāśritatvapakṣa eva taduktiḥ |
analyzed: vastutas vakṣyamāṇa rītyā dharmi sattā sama sattāka bhedasya sādhya śarīra ghaṭaka tāyām ātma āśritatva pakṣe siddhasādhana anavakāśāt antaḥkaraṇa āśritatva pakṣe eva tad uktiḥ
dvitīya pakṣam dūṣayati svarūpa iti ātma svarūpa iti arthaḥ
dravya samavetasya eva guṇa tvena svarūpa sukhasya atathātvāt svarūpa asiddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: siddhānte tu tasya svarūpatve'pyātmaviśeṣatayā guṇatvamastyeveti dhyeyam |
analyzed: siddhānte tu tasya svarūpa tve pi ātma viśeṣatayā guṇatvam asti eva iti dhyeyam

eka svāmikayoḥ ghaṭa paṭayoḥ iti agrima grantha virodhāt
kintu sva svāmi bhāva vyavahāra niyāmakaḥ tad sattā niyāmaka tva ādi lakṣaṇaḥ dharma viśeṣaḥ

atas phalataḥ caitra maitra ātmanoḥ bheda siddhiḥ

original: atra tadviruddhaceṣṭāvattvaṃ tadavṛttikriyāvattvaṃ, tatkriyāvijātīyakriyāvattvaṃ veti manvāno dūṣayati -- ityatreti || vyabhicāramupapādayati -- ekasvāmikayoriti || maitrasvāmikayorityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atra tad viruddha ceṣṭāvat tvam tad avṛtti kriyāvat tvam tad kriyā vijātīya kriyāvat tvam vā iti manvānaḥ dūṣayati iti atra iti vyabhicāram upapādayati eka svāmikayoḥ iti maitra svāmikayoḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tathāca maitraśarīraviruddhaceṣṭāvati ghaṭādau tatsvāmibhinnasvāmikatvābhāvāt, yo yadviruddhaceṣṭāśrayaḥ sa tatsvāmibhinnasvāmika iti sāmānyavyāptau ghaṭaviruddhaceṣṭāvati paṭādau tatsvāmibhinnasvāmikatvābhāvādapi vyabhicāra iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca maitra śarīra viruddha ceṣṭāvati ghaṭa ādau tad svāmi bhinna svāmika tva abhāvāt yaḥ yad viruddha ceṣṭā āśrayaḥ sa tad svāmi bhinna svāmikaḥ iti sāmānya vyāptau ghaṭa viruddha ceṣṭāvati paṭa ādau tad svāmi bhinna svāmika tva abhāvāt api vyabhicāraḥ iti bhāvaḥ
nanu śarīra tve sati tad viruddha ceṣṭāvat tvam eva hetuḥ

original: ato noktavyabhicāra ityata āha -- śarīratveneti || śarīratvaviśiṣṭaniruktaceṣṭāvattvasya hetutve'pītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas na ukta vyabhicāraḥ iti atas āha śarīra tvena iti śarīra tva viśiṣṭa nirukta ceṣṭāvat tvasya hetu tve api iti arthaḥ
yadi api sākṣāt prayatna janya kriyā rūpa ceṣṭā padārtha vivakṣayā eva ukta doṣa vāraṇa sambhavāt tādṛśa kriyā āśraya tva rūpa śarīra tvasya pṛthak upādānam anucitam

vimata tva mātrasya pakṣatā avacchedaka tvāt bhinnau iti mithas bhinnau iti arthaḥ
vimata tva vyāpya dharma avacchinna pratiyogitāka bhedavantau iti yāvat
viruddha dharma adhikaraṇa tvāt paraspara vṛtti abhāva pratiyogi dharmavat tvāt
vimata tva samāna adhikaraṇa abhāva pratiyogi dharmavat tvāt iti yāvat

atra yaḥ yad dharma samāna adhikaraṇa abhāva pratiyogi dharmavān sa tad dharma vyāpya dharma avacchit pratiyogitāka bhedavān iti sāmānya vyāptyā dahana tuhina ubhaya tva adhikaraṇa dahana ādi vṛti abhāva pratiyogi śetyādi vat tuhina ādeḥ tad ubhaya tva vyāpya dahana tva ādi avacchinna pratiyogitāka bhedavat tva vat

prakṛtasya īśvara ādeḥ ukta vimata tva adhikaraṇa jīva ādi vṛtti abhāva pratiyogi svātantrya ādimattvena tādṛśa vimata tva vyāpya jīva tva ādi avacchinna pratiyogitāka bhedavat tvam siddhi ati iti āśayaḥ
yat vā ayam tad bhinnaḥ tad niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi dharmavat tvāt
sa ca etad bhinnaḥ etad niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi dharmavat tvāt

original: yo yanniṣṭhābhāvapratiyogidharmavān sa tadbhinno dahananiṣṭhābhāvapratiyogiśaityādhikaraṇatuhinavaditi samūhālambanānumāne tātparyam |
analyzed: yaḥ yad niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi dharmavān sa tad bhinnaḥ dahana niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi śaitya adhikaraṇa tuhina vat iti samūhālambana anumāne tātparyam

original: tena jīveśvarobhayaṃ pakṣīkṛtya bhedamātrasādhane ghaṭādibhedamādāyārthāntaraṃ, parasparabhedasādhane'pi tasya pratyekaṃ jīvabhedādirūpatvādaṃśe bādhaḥ, evaṃ jīvaviruddhadharmavattvādeḥ pratyekaṃ bhāgāsiddhiḥ, pakṣadṛṣṭāntayoḥ sādhyahetvananugamaścetyādidoṣānavakāśaḥ |
analyzed: tena jīva īśvara ubhayam pakṣīkṛtya bheda mātra sādhane ghaṭa ādi bhedam ādāya artha antaram paraspara bheda sādhane api tasya pratyekam jīva bheda ādi rūpatvāt aṃśe bādhaḥ evam jīva viruddha dharmavat tva ādeḥ pratyekam bhāga asiddhiḥ pakṣa dṛṣṭāntayoḥ sādhya hetu ananugamaḥ ca ityādi doṣa anavakāśaḥ
atra pāramārthika tva viśeṣitaḥ tad aviśeṣitaḥ vā bhedaḥ sādhyaḥ

original: ādye doṣamāha -- pāramārthiketi || antye doṣamāha -- apāramārthiketi || pāramārthikatvāviśeṣitetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ādye doṣam āha pāramārthika iti antye doṣam āha apāramārthika iti pāramārthika tva aviśeṣita iti arthaḥ
na tu apāramārthika tva viśeṣa titā iti arthaḥ
ubhaya a viśeṣita bheda sādhana pakṣa a pratikṣepeṇa nyūna tā āpatteḥ
sa ca aparamārthika tva viśeṣitaḥ na vā iti anyat etat
ātma bheda sādhaka anumāna nirākaraṇam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti ukta rītyā bheda sādhaka anumāna mātrasya ābhāsatvāt iti arthaḥ
bhede jīva īśvara bheda inumānam na pramāṇam iti arthaḥ

original: dvitīyanirākaraṇaṃ pratijānīte || nāpīti || jīveśvarabheda iti vartate tatra tāvadātmamātrabhedasādhakānumānadvayamanūdya dūṣayati -- ātmatvamityādinā || atrātmatvasya nānavyāktiniṣṭhatvamātmanānātvaṃ vinā na sambhavatītyātmabhedasiddhiḥ || asiddheriti || anyatarāsiddherityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dvitīya nirākaraṇam pratijānīte nā api iti jīva īśvara bhedaḥ iti vartate tatra tāvat ātma mātra bheda sādhaka anumāna dvayam anūdya dūṣayati ātmatvam ityādinā atra ātmatvasya nānā vyākti niṣṭhatvam ātma nānātvam vinā na sambhavati iti ātma bheda siddhiḥ asiddheḥ iti anyatara asiddheḥ iti arthaḥ
tām eva upapādayati ātma aikya vādinām iti mataḥ iti śeṣaḥ

original: vādineti pāṭhe anaṅgīkārādityanvayaḥ || vyaktibhedasyeti || ātmākhyavyaktau bhedasya nānātvasya pramāṇabādhitatvenetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vādinā iti pāṭhe anaṅgīkārāt iti anvayaḥ vyakti bhedasya iti ātma ākhya vyaktau bhedasya nānātvasya pramāṇa bādhita tvena iti arthaḥ

original: bhedābhāve ca vyaktyabhedākhyabādhakasadbhāvādākāśatvavannātmatvaṃ jātiriti bhāvaḥ || nirguṇasyeti || `sākṣī cetā kevalo nirguṇaśce'ti śruteriti bhāvaḥ || guṇāśratvalakṣaṇeti || samavāyikāraṇatvarūpaṃ tu nirvikāratvavādinā nāṅgīkriyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: bheda abhāve ca vyakti abheda ākhya bādhaka sadbhāvāt ākāśa tva vat na ātma tvam jātiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nirguṇasya iti sākṣī cetā kevalaḥ nirguṇaḥ ca iti śruteḥ iti bhāvaḥ guṇa aśra tva lakṣaṇa iti samavāyikāraṇatva rūpam tu nirvikāratva vādinā na aṅgīkriyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: ātmabhede'numānadvayamāśaṅkate -- athetyādinā || anumānadvaye vyabhicāramāśaṅkya nirākaroti || naceti || ākāśasyaikatvena śabdasya nānāvyaktyāśritatvaṃ nāstīti tatrādyānumānasya vyabhicārāt |
analyzed: ātma bhede numāna dvayam āśaṅkate atha ityādinā anumāna dvaye vyabhicāram āśaṅkya nirākaroti na ca iti ākāśasya ekatvena śabdasya nānā vyakti āśrita tvam na asti iti tatra ādya anumānasya vyabhicārāt

original: ata eva śabdatvasya nānāvyaktyāśritāśritatvābhāvena dvitīyānumānasya tatra vyabhicāra ityarthaḥ |

original: dvitīyamāśaṅkya nirākaroti || svarūpasukheti || svarūpasukhasya guṇatve ātmanassaguṇatvāpattyā nirguṇaśrutivyākopāditi bhāvaḥ || anyonyajīvabhede'numānamāśaṅkya dūṣayati -- caitraśarīramiti || maitraśarīreti || maitraśarīrasvāmī maitraḥ tadbhinno yastatsvāmikamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dvitīyam āśaṅkya nirākaroti sva rūpa sukha iti sva rūpa sukhasya guṇa tve ātmanaḥ sa guṇa tva āpattyā nirguṇa śruti vyākopāt iti bhāvaḥ anyonya jīva bheda inumānam āśaṅkya dūṣayati caitra śarīram iti maitra śarīra iti maitra śarīra svāmī maitraḥ tad bhinnaḥ yaḥ tad svāmikam iti arthaḥ

original: anena caitraśarīrasvāmini caitre maitrabhedaḥ sidhyati -- tadviruddheti || maitraśarīraceṣṭāviruddhaceṣṭetyarthaḥ |

vyabhicāram upapādayati eka svāmikayoḥ api iti śarīra tvena iti bhogāyatana tvena iti arthaḥ
dṛṣṭānta asiddhiḥ

original: jīveśvarabhede'numānamāśaṅkate -- vimatāviti || pakṣe sarvajñatvālpajñatvādirūpaviruddhadharmo dṛṣṭānte tūṣṇatvaśītatvarūpau draṣṭavyau |
analyzed: jīva īśvara bheda inumānam āśaṅkate vimatau iti pakṣe sarvajñatva alpajñatva ādi rūpa viruddha dharmaḥ dṛṣṭānte tu uṣṇatva śītatva rūpau draṣṭavyau
dahanaḥ vahniḥ tuhinam himam
kim atra pāramārthika bhedaḥ sādhyaḥ uta vyāvahārikaḥ

analyzed: ādye āha pāramārthika iti sādhya tvena abhimatasya pāramārthika bheda rūpasya dharmi viśeṣaṇasya mad mate prasiddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: dvitīya āha -- vyāvahāriketi || vyāvahārikabhedasya mayā'bhyupagamāditi bhāvaḥ |

original: anumānanirākaraṇamupasaṃharati -- tasmāditi || ātmajīvabheda iti || paramātmajīvabhede jīvānāmanyonyabhede cetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: anumāna nirākaraṇam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti ātma jīva bhede iti paramātma jīva bhede jīvānām anyonya bhede ca iti arthaḥ

original: lokavyavahārasiddho yo jīveśvarabhedastasyānuvādaka eva na pratipādako lokavyavahārastu andhaparamparāprāpto na pramāṇamūlaka iti bhāvaḥ |

original: nanvadhikavidhānādyamāvena vṛthā'nuvādāyogātpratipādakatvamevāsyetyata āha -- anuvādaśceti || yathā kathāyāṃ vādyuktasya dūṣaṇāya prativādino'nuvāda ityarthaḥ |

original: ghṛtameva yadvyañcakaṃ tadvinā tatpratyakṣābhāva ityanvavavyatirekasiddhavyañjakatākaghṛtābhāve svavyañjakasāmānyābhāvaprāptyā tadabhāvakāle yathā na gandhapratyakṣaṃ tathehāpi parimāṇaviśeṣavaddravyatvenāṃśaviśeṣapratyakṣatvāvacchinnaṃ prati niyamena hetutvāṅgīkārāddhaṭādyabhāve svavyañjakatvāvacchinnābhāvasattvātpratyakṣābhāvo yukta eveti bhāvaḥ
analyzed: ghṛtam eva yat vyañcakam tat vinā tad pratyakṣa abhāvaḥ iti anvava vyatireka siddha vyañjakatāka ghṛta abhāve sva vyañjaka sāmānya abhāva prāptyā tad abhāva kāle yathā na gandha pratyakṣam tathā iha api parimāṇa viśeṣavat dravya tvena aṃśa viśeṣa pratyakṣa tva avacchinnam prati niyamena hetu tva aṅgīkārāt dhaṭa ādi abhāve sva vyañjaka tva avacchinna abhāva sattvāt pratyakṣa abhāvaḥ yuktaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: pradīpākhyavyañjakābhāve'pyandhakāre tvagindriyeṇa ghaṭākhyavyaṅgyapratītidarśanena tādṛśaniyamābhāvāditi pariharati -- neti || nanu dvividhaṃ vyajakaṃ niyatamaniyatañca |

original: naca na ghṛtābhāvātkuṅkumagandhānupalabdhiḥ kintu kuṅkume gandhasyaivābhāvāditi vācyam |

original: nanvatrākāśabhedasya pramāṇasiddhatvena ghaṭasyābhivyañjakatvaṃ kalpyata ityata āha -- naceti || yena ghaṭasya vyañjakatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ |

original: iha pakṣī neha pakṣīti pratītireva mānamiti cenna |

original: tathāca pakṣyāśraya eko bhāgastadabhāvāśraya eko bhāga iti bhāgabhedaḥ sidhyatīti bhāvaḥ || ālokamaṇḍaleti || tathā ceheti nākāśabhāgapratītiḥ kintvālokamaṇḍalamevehapratītiviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca pakṣi āśrayaḥ ekaḥ bhāgaḥ tad abhāva āśrayaḥ ekaḥ bhāgaḥ iti bhāga bhedaḥ sidhyati iti bhāvaḥ āloka maṇḍala iti tathā ca iha iti na ākāśa bhāga pratītiḥ kintu āloka maṇḍalam eva iha pratīti viṣayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nahi tatrāpyālokamaṇḍalameveheti pratīyata iti vaktuṃ śakyam |

original: tadvadiha pakṣītyatrāpi sa eva viṣayaḥ kinnāṅgīkriyata ityāśaṅkya tasyāpyanyathopapattimāha -- nehā'loka itīti |

original: iha tantuṣu paṭa itivadihā'lokāvayaveṣvāloka iti pratītirupapadyata iti bhāvaḥ |

original: ālokāvayaveṣu bhāsamāneṣu satsu nehā'loka iti pratītyanupapatteḥ |

original: atastatrākāśabhāga evehapratyayaviṣaya ityaṅgīkāryamityata āha -- nehā'loka iti || tatra gaganamevehapratyayaviṣayo na tadbhāga ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas tatra ākāśa bhāgaḥ eva iha pratyaya viṣayaḥ iti aṅgīkāryam iti atas āha na iha ālokaḥ iti tatra gaganam eva iha pratyaya viṣayaḥ na tad bhāgaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: nehā'loka ityatra gaganasya viṣayateti dvaividhyakalpane na kiñcinmūlam |

original: vinā svadṛṣṭipakṣapātādityasvarasādāha -- ihā'loka iti pratītiriti || yathā gaganasya gaganāśrayatābhāve'pīha gaganamiti gaganāśrayatāpratītiraupacārikī evamālokasyālokāśrayatvābhāve'pīhā'loka ityālokasyaivālokāśrayatvena pratīteraupacārikatvopapattyā nānayā pratītyā gagane bhāgabhedasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vinā sva dṛṣṭi pakṣapātāt iti asvarasāt āha iha ālokaḥ iti pratītiḥ iti yathā gaganasya gagana āśraya tā abhāve pi iha gaganam iti gagana āśraya tā pratītiḥ aupacārikī evam ālokasya āloka āśraya tva abhāve pi iha ālokaḥ iti ālokasya eva āloka āśraya tvena pratīteḥ aupacārika tva upapattyā na anayā pratītyā gagane bhāga bheda siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ
atra pratīteḥ aupacārika tvam nāma bheda abhāve pi ādhāra ādheya bhāva avagāhi tvena amukhya artha viṣayaka tvam
ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ hi bheda samāna adhikaraṇaḥ mukhyaḥ
tad asamāna adhikaraṇaḥ tu amukhyaḥ vivakṣitaḥ

original: evañca sarvapadārthānāmabhedamaṅgīkṛtya sarvatra sarvadharmāṅgīkāre'pi pratiniyatavyavahārasiddhyarthaṃ vyavasthāviśeṣo'ṅgīkartavya eveti naivāsmābhirasiddhiḥ supariharetyāha -- neti || sarvatra sarvadharmāṅgīkāre'pi ghaṭatvātyantābhāvo ghaṭa eva pratiyogisamānādhikaraṇaḥ |

original: vyāvahārikabhedamātreṇa ghaṭe paṭāvṛttidharmopapattau pāramārthikaprayojako heturityatastarkamāha -- ghaṭapaṭayośceti || jīvabrahmatādātmyasya pāramārthikatvena yathā tatsambandhinorjīvabrahmaṇoḥ pāramārthikatvaṃ tatheti bhāvaḥ || vāco yuktiriti || vācaḥ prayogaḥ |

original: yathā paṭe ghaṭatvasya mithyātvena tatra tadatyantābhāvastathā ghaṭe'pi ghaṭatvasya mithyātvena tatrāpi tadatyantābhāvaḥ |

anyathā bhāvasya tena api aṅgīkṛta tvāt doṣa anivṛtteḥ

original: evañca ghaṭe āvidyakaghaṭatvasattve'vidyāyā api vyavahāranirodho na sambhavatīti bhāvaḥ |

original: prakṛte ghaṭapaṭavyavahārasya kadā'pyabhāvāditi nātrāvidyākṛtastannirodha iti bhāvaḥ |

original: avidyaiva vyavahāraniyāmikā sā yathā janayati tathā vyavahāro bhavati |

original: || na hīti || avidyā śuktāvāropitarajatābhāve'pīdaṃ rajatamiti vyavahāraṃ te tava mate'pi janayati kiṃ ? na hi janayatītyarthaḥ |

original: iṣṭāpattau bādhakamāha -- tathātva iti || nanvārope sati nimittānusaraṇam |
analyzed: iṣṭa āpattau bādhakam āha tathātve iti nanu ārope sati nimitta anusaraṇam

original: na hi nimittamastītyāropa iti nyāyena vyavahārasattve tasyāvidyāmūlakatvaṃ kalpyate |
